title: Which Emma Stone Character Are You, Actually?
dek: Eight iconic roles, eight wildly different energies — one of them is basically your personality on screen.

quiz.intro: No wrong answers here — just answer like you actually would, not like you think you should.

questions.question: Your friend group is planning a night out. What's your contribution to the plan?

answers.text: I already made a scandalous rumor about myself just to see who reacts
I found us a jazz club nobody's heard of yet
I'm mentally rehearsing my exit line in case it gets weird
I'm plotting who I need to sit next to for maximum influence

questions.question: Someone spreads a nasty rumor about you. What's your move?

answers.text: Get quietly hurt, then pour it into something I'm making
Have a full breakdown about it, alone, out loud, to myself
Use it as leverage against whoever started it
Ask, genuinely, why lying is a thing people do

questions.question: What's your idea of a perfect first date?

answers.text: Honestly I'd rather be reviewing my own performance afterward
One where I come out of it with something I wanted going in
One where I get to try something for the very first time
One dramatic enough to end in a public scene

questions.question: How do you handle being underestimated?

answers.text: I use it. Being underestimated is basically a weapon
I don't understand the concept — I'm learning everything for the first time anyway
I make sure they never underestimate me again
Good. Means they won't see it coming

questions.question: Pick a survival skill you'd want in an apocalypse.

answers.text: Fearlessness, because I don't know enough to be scared yet
Style. If I'm going down, I'm going down looking incredible
Actual rules I follow religiously, plus really good aim
The ability to get people to trust me with their secrets

questions.question: What's your relationship with the truth?

answers.text: The truth about me is a performance and I control every word of it
I trust actions over words, always
I think the truth deserves to be published even if it costs me something
It's flexible, depending on the story I'm telling that week
I keep people at arm's length so I don't get hurt again
I get so focused on the story I almost miss what's in front of me
I care way too much what people think, even while pretending I don't
I sacrifice almost everything for one big dream

questions.question: Someone finally sees the real you. How do you feel?

answers.text: Vindicated — I did the work to get here
Relieved — the persona was exhausting to keep up anyway
Terrified but also finally, finally understood
Suspicious that it's not real applause

questions.question: Last one: what do you actually want people to remember about you?

answers.text: That I was funny, even when the joke was on me
That I chased the dream even when it wasn't easy or convenient
That I mattered, even for one performance
That I survived and won on my own terms

results.name: Olive Penderghast
results.subtitle: Easy A (2010)
results.description: You turn gossip into a whole personal brand and somehow come out on top every time. You've got a sharp tongue, a flair for the dramatic, and a weirdly healthy sense of humor about your own reputation.

results.name: Mia Dolan
results.subtitle: La La Land (2016)
results.description: You're a hopeless romantic who'll chase the dream even when it costs you the relationship, the comfort, everything. You believe in fools who dream — because you're one of them.

results.name: Sam Thomson
results.subtitle: Birdman (2014)
results.description: You're self-aware to a fault, allergic to phoniness, and can smell a fragile ego from a mile away — probably because you're managing one yourself. Underneath the sarcasm, you actually want to matter.

results.name: Abigail Masham
results.subtitle: The Favourite (2018)
results.description: You came from nothing and you are absolutely not going back — whatever it takes. Charming on the surface, ruthless underneath, you always know exactly which room you need to be in.

results.name: Bella Baxter
results.subtitle: Poor Things (2023)
results.description: You experience the world like it's brand new every single day, and you refuse to feel shame about wanting what you want. You're curious, blunt, occasionally chaotic, and completely, gloriously unfiltered.

results.name: Cruella de Vil
results.subtitle: Cruella (2021)
results.description: You turned every rejection into fuel and every insult into a look. You know exactly who you are, you're not asking permission to be it, and honestly? The villain era suits you.

results.name: Wichita
results.subtitle: Zombieland (2009)
results.description: You survive by trusting almost no one, keeping your rules close, and always having an exit plan. Under the tough exterior is someone fiercely loyal to the very few people who actually earn it.

results.name: Skeeter Phelan
results.subtitle: The Help (2011)
results.description: You notice the stories other people are too scared or too comfortable to tell, and you go after them anyway. You'd rather ruffle every feather in town than stay quiet about something that matters.
